notes: Reviewed all twelve views. White dinner jacket, contrasting trousers, lapels and bow tie.
limitations: Standalone static OBJ conversion; no rig, skin weights or automatic fitting are provided, and compatibility with any body shape has not been verified.
Diffuse texture and declared normal map (when present) are preserved; legacy specular, bump and other shader parameters are not reproduced.
Khronos validation has zero errors and 1 runtime-generated tangent-space warning(s); normal-map shading can vary by renderer.
Textured game-asset geometry, not photorealistic; some surfaces show visible faceting.
Coordinated upper-and-lower clothing set only; footwear is not included, so this is not a complete head-to-toe outfit.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
